answer_1.quote: To bridge the gap of the knowledge between the human and the machine, researchers have begun to introduce large-scale knowledge graphs for enhancing the dialogue generation ... this paper proposes a Context Knowledge-Aware Diverse and Informative conversation generation model, ConKADI.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated responses from four aspects: Knowledge Utilization (E match, E use, E recall), Embedding-based Relevance (Emb avg, Emb ex), Overlapping-based Relevance (BLEU-2/3), Diversity (Distinct-1/2), Informativeness (Entropy).

answer_4.quote: We invite three well-educated volunteers to judge which response is better, in terms of appropriateness (fluency and logical relevance) and informativeness (provides new information/knowledge).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators compare pairs of responses and rate them on appropriateness and informativeness, allowing ties but encouraging decisive judgments.
